analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, patches and supplied source excerpts against the canonical definition index and selected T-041 detail. These units change documentation only; no concrete security regression is established. changelog.d/coordinator-reconnect-stall.md:3-4 describes bounded handshake retries and acknowledgement-free drain only without a registered session or unfinished requests. docs/provider/cli-reference.md head:444-448 preserves acknowledgement for registered sessions; head:1974 documents a 30-second TCP/TLS/WebSocket deadline. Unchanged surrounding documentation retains native-owner retirement (base:440-444), terminal usage barriers (base:329-349), process-exit confirmation and credential revocation separation (base:552-574). Nothing supplied changes encryption, cache scoping, build qualification, privileged helpers or remote revocation policy.
Integration must verify the actual CoordinatorConnectionHandshake.swift and CoordinatorClient+Connection.swift implementation cancels timed-out attempts, prevents late readiness/re-registration and invalidates old connection-bound authorization (TB-002, TB-011, T-053; availability A-018). Verify ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift's no-session drain predicate still includes unfinished terminal usage, local response ownership and native-owner retirement, and cannot race reconnect or new admission (A-001, A-009, T-010). Check acknowledgement status propagation through lifecycle receipts and stop/restart/start/logout consumers so 'not needed' never substitutes for remote token revocation (A-008). These are material implementation questions for subsequent source/integration passes, not observed missing controls; implementation is absent from this batch.
